ThingDef.label: Carapace Armor
ThingDef.description: A suit of armor, made up of a lightweight plasteel-weave plates which provide moderate protection and with an integrated webbing system configured for standard infantry use. Created as a cheaper alternative to power armor during conflicts. Armor like this is often used by imperial army regulars and urbworld military forces.

ThingDef.label: Carapace Helmet
ThingDef.description: A armored helmet with built in communication system and a protective plasteel-weave plate. Armor like this is often used by imperial army regulars and urbworld military forces.

ThingDef.label: Medic Carapace Armor
ThingDef.description: A suit of armor, made up of a lightweight plasteel-weave plates which provide moderate protection and with an integrated webbing system configured for providing medical assistance in the field. Created as a cheaper alternative to power armor during conflicts. Armor like this is often used by imperial army regulars and urbworld military forces and is marked as such.

ThingDef.label: Medic Carapace Helmet
ThingDef.description: A armored helmet with built in communication system and a protective plasteel-weave plate. Armor like this is often used by imperial army medics and urbworld military forces and is marked as such.

Created as a cheaper alternative to power armor during conflicts. Armor like this is often used by imperial army commanders and urbworld military officers and is marked as such.

ThingDef.label: Commander Carapace Helmet
ThingDef.description: A armored helmet with built in communication system and a protective plasteel-weave plate. Armor like this is often used by imperial army commanders and urbworld military officers and is marked as such.

ThingDef.label: Assault Carapace Armor
ThingDef.description: A suit of armor, made up of lightweight plasteel-weave plates which provide moderate protection, additional plates fitted for increased protection, and with an integrated webbing system configured for assault and raiding uses. Created as a cheaper alternative to power armor during conflicts. Armor like this is often used by imperial army commandos and urbworld military shocktroopers and is marked as such.

ThingDef.label: Assault Carapace Helmet
ThingDef.description: A armored helmet with built in communication system, a protective plasteel-weave plate, and modified to include a face guard. Armor like this is often used by imperial army commandos and urbworld military shocktroopers and is marked as such.

ThingDef.label: Scout Carapace Armor
ThingDef.description: A suit of armor, made up of lightweight plasteel-weave plates which provide moderate protection, featuring a bandoleer for high caliber bullets, and a thermooptical camoflague generator. Created as a cheaper alternative to power armor during conflicts. Armor like this is often used by imperial army commandos and urbworld military shocktroopers and is marked as such.

HediffDef.label: stealth field emitter
HediffDef.description: A modified stealth system built off of archotech shards. Though inferior compared to designs based on imperial technology. The system can manipulate the visual centers of those nearby, rendering them invisible for a short time.

AbilityDef.label: stealth field
AbilityDef.description: Activate the stealth field, bending light around the wearer to render them invisible for a short time. Weapon usage collapses the stealth field.

ThingDef.label: Scout Carapace Helmet
ThingDef.description: A armored helmet with built in communication system, protective plasteel-weave plate, an advanced targeting system, and a oxygen recycler for hazardous environments. Armor like this is often used by imperial army scouts and urbworld assassins and is marked as such.

ThingDef.label: veteran Carapace Armor
ThingDef.description: A suit of armor, made up of a lightweight plasteel-weave plates which provide moderate protection, additional plating added in the field and with an integrated webbing system modified by veterans in the field. Created as a cheaper alternative to power armor during conflicts. Armor like this is often used by imperial army veterans and urbworld mercenaries.

ThingDef.label: veteran Carapace Helmet
ThingDef.description: A armored helmet with built in communication system, improvised cheek guards and a protective plasteel-weave plate. Armor like this is often used by imperial army veterans and urbworld mercenaries.
